process.defaultTitle: Get Brand New Floors in 4 Simple Steps
process.defaultDescription: A clear, step-by-step process so your flooring project stays organized, efficient, and stress-free from start to finish.

steps.title: Old Flooring & Haul Away
steps.description: We remove your existing carpet, tile, or other flooring and haul it away so the space is clear and ready for installation.
steps.imageAlt: Crew removing old carpet and hauling flooring debris away

steps.title: Subfloor Preparation
steps.description: We inspect, level, and prepare the subfloor to create a smooth, stable foundation for your new flooring.
steps.imageAlt: Technician leveling and preparing the subfloor

steps.title: Professional Flooring Installation
steps.description: Our experienced installers precisely lay your new flooring for a clean, seamless, and professional finish.
steps.imageAlt: Professional installing new wood-look flooring planks

steps.title: Trim, Fixtures & Final Touches
steps.description: We complete the installation with trim and finishing details, then reinstall removed fixtures and ensure everything is clean, polished, and ready to enjoy.
steps.imageAlt: Installer fitting baseboard trim on newly installed flooring
